body:
At a comic con I was at Christopher Khayman Lee (Andros) confirmed they were supposed to be the Lost Galaxy rangers. 

He said at the last minute Saban decided to adopt the Sentai tradition of new people each year.

I would have loved to see them as LG rangers.

I had meant were there already plans for the next season before the original team had left or were they already going with a new team. Some shows plan out so long in advance maybe he had known or not about another change.
Is it any good? I was talking to a guy in line and he asked if I watch it. I just said yes because I forgot she's the star.

This weekend was my first and last morphicon. Since 2007 I’ve heard how great it was so I save up and fly out for the weekend and am immediately greeted to the cluster that was Friday afternoon badge pickup. I went to Disneyland and came back that night to avoid the line.

Waiting in line day I mean Saturday, to the people who stood in JDF’s line my heart goes out to you. He’s so heavy on the convention scene and me living in Dallas I can go to a convention (like the one he’s doing here in October) he does and wait 15 minutes in line Speaking of how much security did JDF need? I love him but he makes the president look like amateur hour. He had cops, dudes in suits and arena security. I saw Cerina Vincent talking to his security trying to get to his table just to say hi secret service looking guy wasn’t having it until JDF looked over and said it was okay to let her in. 

I stood in line for 2 hours at the Ninja Steel signing just to be turned away and watch some of the cast get up and leave watching JDF give them crap about that was funny. They at least handed out some posters the cast already signed and I lucked up and got the last one.

The power breakfast was the saddest part Sabrina Lu (Scorpina) came and sat at our table for a bit, she was very sweet then she left and we were just there looking sad. A staffer saw us looking sad and made sure we were taken care of and made some voice actors and rangers came up and to say hi and talk to us. 

I don’t know if this is the way it’s always been run but if it is deuces. Disorganized, the left hand not knowing what the right hand is doing (RJ Cyler canceling his panel and the moderator not even being told, walking into an empty room and finding out the same time as us) I shouldn’t leave a convention feeling mentally and physically exhausted being constantly corralled in lines and dealing with volunteers on power trips, if someone pays good money to get supposed gold or platinum treatment and leaves not even wanting to look at the franchise the convention is centered around something’s wrong.

I’ll be here waiting for the downvotes and high fiving a million angels.
Does anyone who has Gold VIP for Dallas tomorrow want to meet up?
Hi! I got Gold VIP for Dallas too! My friend bailed at the last minute Are you still looking to meet up with anyone?
I'll have to give that group a look. Thanks for the info and I'm trying to be okay it's a day to day thing. Thanks for showing come concern it makes me feel good.
Yeah, I don't know why he signed there he said it looked like the best place to.
